channel.title: Security Brief
channel.description: Original analysis and ranked cybersecurity news with links to original sources

item.title: The edge is where attackers get in: this week's firewall, VPN and remote-access exploits
item.description: Five exploited flaws in firewalls, VPNs, remote-support software and file-sharing servers show one pattern. The systems that sit at the edge of your network, and that administrators manage remotely, are the weakest link. Here is what to check first.

item.title: October 2026 Patch Tuesday: what the Microsoft feed shows and what to do
item.description: The Microsoft feed lists few entries, and most of them are updates to October's release rather than new fixes. The one item that needs planning is a .NET remote code execution flaw that Microsoft has not fixed yet. Identity Web and WSL need version checks if you use them.

item.title: Weekly M365 & Entra Briefing: 13 to 19 October 2026
item.description: Exchange sign-in problems after October Windows Server updates, an identity-based incident at ConnectWise that affected Microsoft 365 tenants, and why device-code abuse is still worth a Conditional Access check.

item.title: Recent UnrealIRCd Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
item.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-114713, the high-severity flaw allows attackers to execute commands with server/IRCOp privileges. The post Recent UnrealIRCd Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
item.description: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned on Tuesday that hackers are now exploiting a high-severity Cisco BroadWorks vulnerability in attacks.

item.title: SCKit abuses ScreenConnect to deploy remote access and target technician sessions
item.description: Beginning on November 11, 2026, ConnectWise reported an active campaign of a threat actor gaining unauthorized access to cloud-hosted ConnectWise ScreenConnect instances belonging to managed service providers (MSPs). Microsoft Threat Intelligence has confirmed ConnectWise’s reported activity and we have also observed…

item.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
item.description: Microsoft did another four-digit patch drop today, releasing updates to fix almost 1,100 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software. This month’s Patch Tuesday addresses 63 critical flaws — including a zero-day in Microsoft Outlook — and comes amid important security updates from…

item.title: IBM Aspera Faspex, SignalWire FreeSwitch Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks
item.description: CISA has added CVE-2026-123218 and CVE-2026-116779 to KEV, urging federal agencies to patch them within three days. The post IBM Aspera Faspex, SignalWire FreeSwitch Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.description: Written by: Aurora Blum, Kelli Vanderlee, Jess Xia, David Mainor Executive Summary As threat actors increasingly move beyond basic prompting to deploying autonomous multi-agent frameworks, automated vulnerability exploitation pipelines, and alternative monetization schemes like LLMJacking, the adversarial AI landscape…

item.title: CVE-2026-111497 Google: CVE-2026-111497 Buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder
item.description: Updated the Security Updates table to include affected Windows versions and the applicable November 2026 security updates. Microsoft recommends that customers install the applicable updates to be protected from this vulnerability.

item.title: November Patch Tuesday: An Overflowing Cornucopia of CVEs
item.description: Microsoft serves up an actively exploited Outlook zero-day, and a wave of critical Exchange, SharePoint, Windows Search, and LDAP bugs that exhausted defenders need to prioritize fast.

item.title: Barracuda links cloud breach to ARTEX AI-powered cyberattack
item.description: Hackers who breached the cloud environment of network and email security company Barracuda earlier this month used a stolen cloud access key and the ARTEX AI penetration testing framework.

item.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks
item.description: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments.

item.title: Critical Xen Orchestra Flaws Exploited in Attacks
item.description: A critical authentication bypass allows attackers to execute arbitrary code as admin and take over XCP-ng nodes. The post Critical Xen Orchestra Flaws Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,235 flaws, Outlook zero-day
item.description: Today is Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday, with security updates addressing a record-breaking 1,235 flaws, including one actively exploited Microsoft Outlook zero-day vulnerability.

item.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Xen Orchestra Auth Bypass Flaw to Gain Admin Access
item.description: French software company Vates VMS has warned of a critical security vulnerability in Xen Orchestra that it said is being actively exploited in the wild. The authentication bypass flaw, which does not yet have a CVE identifier, is tracked as VSA-2026-062. "REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into…

item.title: Critical Xen Orchestra auth bypass flaw exploited to hijack VM servers
item.description: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Xen Orchestra is being actively exploited in attacks that could grant administrator privileges and allow takeover of XCP-ng virtualization hosts.

item.title: Ransomware Attacks Increase Behind AI, But Payments Decline
item.description: Large language models and other AI systems allow a growing number of ransomware groups to create convincing phishing emails and identify sensitive data quickly.

item.title: China-Nexus Actors Breach 10 Organizations in AI-Driven Attacks
item.description: Attackers used Cairn once again in autonomous attacks that targeted advanced manufacturing and defense sectors, as well as civil and human rights organizations.

item.title: CVE-2026-124222 Microsoft Office SharePoint Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
item.description: Information published. This CVE was addressed by updates that were released in November 2026, but the CVE was inadvertently omitted from the November 2026 Security Updates. This is an informational change only. Customers who have already installed the November 2026 updates do not need to take any further action.

item.title: TSMC employee data breach linked to cloud provider
item.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) confirmed that personal employee data has been leaked online after a threat actor put 6.9GB of information allegedly stolen from the company up for auction.

item.title: CVE-2026-109473 Windows Kernel Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
item.description: Updated an acknowledgement. This is an informational change only.

item.title: Ransomware attack on Belarusian cloud firm disrupts businesses for days
item.description: ActiveCloud said hackers had breached its systems and encrypted parts of its cloud infrastructure, leaving customers unable to access key services for several days.

item.title: PHP2Shell Exploited in Destructive Check Point Gateway Attacks
item.description: PHP2Shell enabled initial compromise, while CVE-2026-123039 allowed attackers to elevate privileges to root. The post PHP2Shell Exploited in Destructive Check Point Gateway Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Kazakhstan-linked hackers used AI agent to spy on Central Asian governments
item.description: Suspected Kazakhstan-linked hackers used an artificial intelligence agent to help spy on Central Asian governments, steal sensitive documents and infiltrate critical infrastructure networks, according to new research.

item.title: Threat Actors Exploit Openwave, Cisco BroadWorks Vulnerabilities
item.description: The flaws, CVE-2026-111793 and CVE-2026-20320, let attackers leak sensitive information, including configuration data. The post Threat Actors Exploit Openwave, Cisco BroadWorks Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.description: Anbieter Barracuda hat zum 2. November 2026 die beiden Schwachstellen CVE-2026-116606 und CVE-2026-111560 gepatcht. item.title: Google patches eighth Chrome zero-day exploited in attacks this year
item.description: Google has released emergency security updates to patch a new Chrome vulnerability exploited in zero-day attacks, the eighth such flaw since the start of the year.

item.title: Russia denies intercepting Romanian government emails
item.description: Russia has denied accusations that its state-backed hackers targeted a Romanian government institution in an attempt to intercept emails exchanged with NATO and the European Union.

item.title: Microsoft says months-old bug caused global Microsoft 365 outage
item.description: Microsoft says a software bug introduced in July caused last week's worldwide Microsoft 365 outage, triggering a cascading failure that left more than 80% of its networking gateway servers unresponsive.

item.title: Fandango says hackers stole payment card details from checkout pages
item.description: Ticket seller Fandango Media is notifying customers about a data breach that exposed payment card details entered on its checkout pages.

item.title: Lithuanian customs agency restores services after cyberattack, possible data breach
item.description: A November 10 attack prompted Lithuanian Customs to temporarily shut down its main user management portal. It made progress on fixing the problem over the weekend.

item.title: Microsoft: Windows Server 2016 reaches end of support in 60 days
item.description: Microsoft has reminded customers again that Windows Server 2016 will stop receiving security updates after it reaches the end of support in two months.

item.title: Uber Data Breach Impacts 150,000 People
item.description: Hackers compromised a third-party services provider and stole names, addresses, and driver’s license numbers. The post Uber Data Breach Impacts 150,000 People appeared first on SecurityWeek.

Central to the intrusion is a toolkit called SANSAR, a Rust-based orchestrator that receives commands over the TOR…

item.title: Microsoft pushes Windows emergency updates to fix activation failures
item.description: Microsoft has released emergency out-of-band updates to fix Windows activation and licensing failures caused by this month's security updates.

item.title: Microsoft Rules Out Cyberattack in Outage, Warns of Phishing Campaign
item.description: Phishing emails posing as Microsoft 365 service notices referenced the real outage incident and threatened to delete held messages. The post Microsoft Rules Out Cyberattack in Outage, Warns of Phishing Campaign appeared first on SecurityWeek.
